title: The tree on the desk, 2021
logline: The motel desk with the small tinsel tree on it, from the lot through the glass, and behind the desk this year nobody — the page arrives between shifts. The tree, the bell, the pad, the sodium light.

panels.composition: A motel office at night through its glass door: a small tinsel tree on the desk, a bell and a pad, no one behind the desk, orange sodium light on the lot.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a motel office at night seen through its glass door with a small tinsel tree on the desk beside a bell and a pad and no one behind it, orange sodium light on the lot, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
